list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden, 27 visible
list_note: The trophy names, descriptions and grades come from the Exophase list, and the other six guides agree with it on all 55 entries. The hidden split is the reported one — 28 hidden (27 bronze plus 1 gold) — with story trophies and the cryptic one-liners hidden until you earn them. GTA VI launched on 19 November 2026, and the sources below were read on 20 November 2026. When no player-verified method exists for a trophy, the guide admits that instead of making one up; when two sources give different counts, the guide shows both.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum unlocks on its own the instant the last one pops, and there is nothing extra to do for it.
Work the roadmap in order — story, side strands, map sweep, activities, money, then the 100% cleanup — and the platinum will be the last trophy you earn.
Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission, through to the end — it is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed.
Keep following the objectives on screen until the mission-complete screen appears; the trophy pops there.
Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. It comes from playing the story, so it is unmissable.
Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot — Lucia's balcony — for Positive Mental Attitude. That spot is reported to vanish once the chapter is over.
Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
This is the chapter where both protagonists become playable, which opens most of the side content — start taking stranger missions and trying activities between story beats.
Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
Save by hand at the start of the chapter — guides advise one manual save per chapter, because there is reportedly no mission replay.
Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
Use the quiet stretches between story missions to pick up collectibles — cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles — instead of leaving all of them for after the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Play the final story mission through to the end — the only hidden gold trophy. It is unmissable as long as you finish the story.
Save by hand before you start it: it is the natural point of no return, and a save here lets you mop up anything left over without replaying the finale.
Complete the story mission Breakfast Run — it unlocks through normal story progress, so it cannot be missed.
Keep playing the story; the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.
Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist — it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.
Do any setup the game asks for first, then run the heist itself.
Complete the story mission Child's Play — it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.
Follow the mission objectives to the end; it pops on the complete screen.
Complete the story mission Headliners — it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.
Follow the mission objectives through to the complete screen.
Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — VCIA is Vice City International Airport — it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.
Follow the mission objectives through to the complete screen.
Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory — it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.
Follow the mission objectives through to the complete screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Reach 100% on the game's in-game completion checklist — the hardest trophy in the set, in a platinum run rated around 200 hours in total.
The checklist is the usual GTA mix: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration.
Do not leave it to the end blind: tick off this guide's counted trophies as you go — stunts, races, challenges, cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas — and 100% will be nearly done when the story ends.
Once the story is done, open the in-game checklist and treat whatever is left as your cleanup list.

trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and similar driving feats, tracked by the game's stunt counter.
It builds up across the whole playthrough, so drive fast and jump often from the start instead of saving it for the end.
Check the counter in the stats menu to see how far along you are.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone racing and the other open-world activities are the pool to draw from.
You only have to try each type, not win or master it, so sample everything as it unlocks and this pops early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Find a shooting range and work through its challenge list — 42 challenges in total.
Replay any challenge until you hit the gold score; there is no limit on retries.
Do a few each visit rather than all 42 in one sitting, and use the weapon each challenge is built for.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — a win at every one, not 14 wins at the same spot.
Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race to win; the counter is per location.
Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one.
Work through the race list across Leonida; street, off-road and water races all count toward the set.
Pick the fastest vehicle you own for each race type.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head: out-fish him within the challenge's rules (a bigger catch or more fish, as the challenge states).
If you lose, retry — fishing challenges can be attempted again.
Try regular fishing first so you know the minigame before facing Cal.
Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, any title.
You do not need a high score or a win, just a completed game.
Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission — take Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Not missable: stranger and side missions stay available in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission — take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission — take Billy's missions as they appear.
Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore.
Start one, follow its strand to the end, and repeat until 8 strands are done.
The named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the strands, so you need three more beyond them.
Not missable: strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission — take Randy's missions as they appear.
Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission — take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots by the count GTABase, GamesRadar+ and Push Square report.
Do the first spot at once: Lucia's balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1. It is reported gone after that chapter, and there is reportedly no mission replay.
Meditate at every spot the moment you find it and never walk past one; keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net.
Track your progress in-game: Touch Pad, then Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Discovered spots also show on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
If a spot will not trigger, try approaching it as the character the spot belongs to.

trophies.disagree_note: Sources disagree on the count: GTABase, GamesRadar+ and Push Square say 18 meditation spots, while the in-game 100% checklist is reported to count 15. The trophy and the checklist may count different things — this guide reports both numbers instead of choosing one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Talk to Bret to start his hunt strand, then follow his directions to the animal's territory.
Take the unique animal down with a clean shot — hunting trophies in GTA usually want the animal killed, not just found.
If the animal does not appear, check the time of day and weather the hunt hints at.
Complete 3 full collectible card sets — cards are scattered across Leonida, in shops, interiors and out in the world.
A set only counts when every card in it is found, so collect cards as you explore rather than hunting them all at the end.
Use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are one or two cards short.
Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations across Leonida — visit a spot, use the action, and move on.
Do it alongside the 52-area exploration (The Goodtime State) and the 100-vehicle discovery (Whip It Good): the three overlap naturally as you cover the map.
Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the assorted feats the game tracks (driving, combat, exploration and activity challenges).
Pick the easiest ones first from the challenges menu and let the rest accumulate naturally.
50 is a large share of the list, so expect this late in the playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level — the partner requirement is the trick, so do it during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is with you.
Lose the cops and escape: break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
Fast cars and the countryside help more than hiding in the city.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — the run fails if the wanted level drops to zero between robberies.
Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them so the heat stays on.
Do it with your partner present; solo robberies do not count.
Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter each one and it counts toward the total.
It accumulates naturally across a full playthrough if you vary what you drive.
To finish it, sweep the map's distinct districts and vehicle types (cars, bikes, boats, trucks) rather than driving the same car all game; the in-game vehicle list shows what you have found.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Pick a fight with a group of at least 5 enemies — gang hideouts and police chases give you the crowd you need.
Trigger Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode) and drop all 5 before it ends.
Do not let the meter run out with enemies still standing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — in plain words, steal a plane and take off without following the airport's rules.
Get airside, take a plane, and get airborne; expect a wanted level on the way out.
No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description, so treat the runway takeoff as the goal and improvise the approach.
The description is the only confirmed hint — “Kinda hot in these Rhinos” points at the Rhino tank.
The sensible reading: get into a Rhino tank and cause havoc with it (drive it, fire it, survive the wanted level it brings).
No verified method exists yet, so do not trust a specific step-by-step claim until players confirm one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab.
Case the store, go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm.
If you are spotted, leave and retry: detection fails the attempt.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — bank vault robberies are the bigger heist-style robberies.
Plan each one (approach, entry, escape route) and do not linger after the vault is open, since the escape is part of the trophy.
Five separate successful vault robberies are needed.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Rob one armored truck and escape — armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida.
Stop one (ram it or block the road), crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police box you in.
A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape part far easier.
Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — Vice City, the Keys, the Everglades and every named district in between.
An area counts when you enter it; the map fills in as you go, so sweep the edges of the map systematically and check which areas are still unvisited.
Pair this with WAiNK It (100 locations) and vehicle discovery (100 vehicles) since all three reward covering the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs are reported.
Gangs run their own illicit spots around Leonida — find one operation per gang, hit it and get out.
Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the trophy needs all 9 and it is easy to rob the same gang's spots twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the description is the whole method.
Find a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with a view, buy the cocktail there, and the trophy should pop.
No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description, so do not trust a claim that names a specific bar until players confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front.
Pick a showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and floor it through the window.
The “classic style” wording points at the old GTA showroom-smash gag, so the exit through the glass is the point. No verified method exists yet beyond the description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — “follow-through” suggests completing a full game or a full follow-through on a bowl.
Play a game at that specific alley (not just any bowling lane) and finish it.
No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description.
The description is the only confirmed hint — “a partnership with mass appeal” suggests doing something as a duo (Jason and Lucia together) that draws a crowd or goes public.
No verified method exists yet, and any specific claim about what triggers it is unconfirmed.
Play the partner activities and public-facing side content as they come, and this is likely to pop on its own. Do not trust an unverified how-to.
Make story choices as you play — the description (“choices made, for better or worse”) points at the game's decision moments, and some trackers list a count tied to them.
The exact number of choices needed is unconfirmed, so the honest advice is: do not skip decision prompts, make a choice every time one appears, and keep playing.
It should pop through normal story play.
The description is the only confirmed hint — “second time's the charm” suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing it once.
No verified method exists yet: the sensible approach is to retry things you fail (races, challenges, activities) rather than avoiding failure.
This may pop on a natural retry. Do not trust a specific trigger claim until players confirm one.
The description is the only confirmed hint — “what the hell just happened?” points at a strange, unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida (the classic GTA easter-egg style event).
No verified location or trigger exists yet: explore odd places, investigate strange sights, and this should pop when you stumble into the right event.
Any guide naming an exact spot before players confirm one is guessing.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Knock people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon (a bat, for example) and bowl pedestrians over.
Drive slowly past a group and swing; you need the drive-by melee hit to connect.
Expect a wanted level; do it somewhere you can escape easily. The exact count needed is unconfirmed beyond the description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.
Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — dirty money you cannot spend directly, so take them to your laundering contacts and convert them over time.
The total is cumulative across the whole game, so bank every bill you get instead of ignoring them; by late game the total should be close.
Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell.
The total is cumulative, so it builds naturally if you buy gear as you go.
If you are short late in the game, buy expensive items (weapons and outfits) to top it up. Do not hoard cash for no reason — spending counts here.
Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida, from the in-game property market — check the property listings as new areas open.
Buy each garage when you can afford it.
They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are discovering for Whip It Good, so buy them as you explore.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery/vehicle app.
Open the app on the in-game phone, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered.
It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles (Whip It Good): register each interesting vehicle as you find it.
